news.title: Evergreen Fibreboard Q3 FY2026 Net Loss Narrows to RM4.09m as Revenue Jumps 22.2%, but 9M Loss Widens to RM27.80m

recent_en: EVERGRN reported Q3 FY2026 results with net loss narrowing to RM4.09m on a 22.2% revenue increase, while 9M cumulative loss widened to RM27.80m. The company also announced changes in its Risk Committee and Nomination Committee.
notable_en: Announced Q3 FY2026 results with net loss narrowing to RM4.09m and revenue up 22.2% year-on-year.
Changes in Risk Committee and Nomination Committee involving Mr Shameer Bin Othman and Miss Tan Mui Ping.
risks_en: 9M cumulative net loss widened to RM27.80m.
